name: propose_change
description: Propose ONE change to the Lyon planning model (ontology or rule register) suggested by a message or a piece of feedback. Use only objects, rule types, families, products, lines and customers that exist. If nothing in the model should change, use kind 'none'.

target.description: Object the change applies to (add_field, add_link: subject object)

name.description: Name of the new field, link verb or object

statement.description: rule: the rule in plain words

evidence.description: The words of the source that support the change
